user.title: WristTalk
user.description: Voice assistant for Home Assistant on a Garmin watch.

data_description.pipeline: The Assist pipeline a new watch uses; each watch can pick its own in its device card.
data_description.url: The watch reaches Home Assistant through the phone, which needs HTTPS with a trusted certificate (e.g. Home Assistant Cloud). Plain http:// does not work, also at home.

error.https_required: The address must start with https://

data_description.url:
Saved address: [{url}]({url})

Copy it into the WristTalk settings in the Connect IQ app on your phone. A changed address must reach the watches too: paste it there, or pair the watch again.

error.https_required: The address must start with https://

code.title: Enter the watch's code
code.description:
Enter the 6-digit code shown on the watch.

Watches that asked to pair:
{watches}

Only the watch whose code you type gets a key.

progress.wait_watch:
Open WristTalk on the watch.

In the WristTalk settings in the Connect IQ app on your phone, enter the house address:

[**{url}**]({url})

Pairing is open for 3 minutes.
progress.wait_watch_again:
**{watch}**

Open WristTalk on the watch. When it shows a pairing code, type it in the next step.

No code on the watch? In its menu (hold UP) choose **Pair again**.

Pairing is open for 3 minutes.
progress.wait_key:
**{watch}**

**Code accepted.** Waiting for the watch to collect its key.

If WristTalk is not open on the watch, open it.

abort.timeout: No watch asked to pair within 3 minutes. Click **+ Add watch** again.
abort.too_many_codes: A wrong code was entered 3 times, so pairing was closed. Click **+ Add watch** again.
abort.paired_again: The watch is paired again. Its settings were kept.
abort.timeout_again: The watch did not ask to pair within 3 minutes. Click the **⚙** next to the watch again.
abort.expired: Pairing ended after 3 minutes, before the code was typed. Click **+ Add watch** again - the watch shows a new code.
abort.expired_again: Pairing ended after 3 minutes, before the code was typed. Click the **⚙** next to the watch again - the watch shows a new code.
abort.too_many_codes_again: A wrong code was entered 3 times, so pairing was closed. Click the **⚙** next to the watch again.
abort.not_collected: The watch did not collect its key before pairing ended, so nothing was saved. Open WristTalk on the watch and click **+ Add watch** again.
abort.not_collected_again: The watch did not collect its key before pairing ended, so nothing changed. Open WristTalk on the watch and click the **⚙** next to the watch again.

error.invalid_code: This code does not match any watch that asked to pair. Check the code on the watch.
error.invalid_format: The code has 6 digits - type all of them as the watch shows.
error.wrong_watch: This code is from another watch. Type the code shown on the watch you are pairing again.
